scope: Existing React RelayOps application; no API or database schema changes
typography: Locally bundled Geist Variable + Geist Mono Variable; existing license provenance retained
decisions: Stable desktop sidebar; mobile horizontal navigation
Account details and help remain discoverable without permanent explanatory panels
Saved views and advanced filters use disclosures; search stays visible
Default table focuses on title, severity, state, affected services, coordinator and elapsed time; all original columns remain selectable
Mobile cards remain virtualized, preserve selection and inspector focus; full table and sorting available
Incident commands precede append-only history; lifecycle track highlights only current state, without implying skipped transitions happened
Light default for new preferences; previously saved dark/system preferences preserved
No invented operational data or new integrations; test records explicitly named Demo

checks.biome: no errors on changed files; existing non-blocking suggestions in E2E files
browserRealAPI: Create incident, assign coordinator, publish update
Second independent browser context receives updates
Resolution summary survives reload and appears remotely
Actual invited Viewer has no write controls; API update returns 403
Saved view persists and filter state lives in URL
Mobile inspector Escape restores original button focus
checks.accessibility: axe serious/critical: zero on Overview, Workbench, Board, Services, Analytics; mobile Workbench also zero; dark Workbench and mobile authentication also zero
checks.responsive: 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px: no document or shell horizontal overflow across five main routes, including reduced motion
automatedE2E: Response Board / two-browser realtime / presence / signal intake: passed, 8.9s
Viewer / Responder / Commander / Service Owner / Admin action visibility: passed, 8.0s
Workbench URL / saved preset / refresh / browser history / second authorized session: passed, 6.4s

limitations: Full repository-wide release/security/performance matrix was not rerun; this is a UI change, not release approval
External OAuth, SMTP delivery and production CAPTCHA were not tested
New helper labels have English fallback outside Russian/English
Generated mockups are visual references; generated fictional integrations and task-board semantics were deliberately excluded from implementation

operations.data: Isolated disposable verification PostgreSQL; existing project volumes and other projects untouched
